title: Weinstein tells Jim Simons about Chern-Simons and Einstein-Hilbert; Stony Brook invitation
place_text: meeting with Jim Simons; Simons Center, Stony Brook

tellings.quote: So, look, I I more or less accused Jim Simons of this shortly before he died.

plain: The mathematician and physicist Eric Weinstein tells Michels that shortly before the mathematician and investor Jim Simons died, he "more or less accused" Simons of what they were discussing on the show, raising Chern-Simons theory, a piece of mathematics Simons helped create, alongside the Einstein-Hilbert equations behind Einstein's theory of gravity. Weinstein says an invitation to the Simons Center at Stony Brook followed. What exactly he accused Simons of, the quote leaves unsaid, but the episode is about secrets in physics he believes the Pentagon keeps.
